simple.meaning: מֶתֶג (metheg) is a Hebrew animal word meaning “a bit.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at 2 Kings 19:28. The background is built from the passages where the word occurs.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מֶתֶג (H4964) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: מֶתֶג (metheg) / H4964 is traced through 2 Kings 19:28, Psalms 32:9, Proverbs 26:3, Isaiah 37:29 with generated occurrence evidence.

definitions.full: H4964. metheg מֶ֫תֶג noun masculine bridle (Aramaic ( ᵑ7 ) מִתְגָּא ; Late Hebrew מֶתֶג of secondary accent ָֽ ; מִתֵּג Pi`el denominative put on a bridle ); — 1 literally bridle , for animals; לַחֲמוֺר מֶתֶג Prov 26:3 a whip for the horse, a bridle for the ass , etc.; ׳בְּמ וָרֶסֶן Psa 32:9 with bridle and halter (on text of verse compare Che); of ׳י 's birdle for Sennach. (under figure of beast), בִּשְׂפָתֶיךָ וּמִתְגִּי 2Kin 19:28 and I will put ( וְשַׂמְתִּי ) my hook in thy nose and my bridle in thy lips = Isa 37:29 (see Dr Is. ed. 2, 220 ). 2 figurative = control, authority , only in ׳מ הָאַמָּה 2Sam 8:1 authority of the mother city , according to MV Buhl, of especially We Dr; Bu omit as corrupt (see I. אַמָּה , above); see, further, HPS. מְתוּשֶׁ֫לַח מְתוּשָׁאֵל, see below מַת above
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root meaning to curb ;

occurrences.englishText: Because of your raging against me, and because your arrogance has come up into my ears, therefore I will put my hook in your nose, and my bridle in your lips, and I will turn you back by the way by which you came.’
Don’t be like the horse, or like the mule, which have no understanding,
A whip is for the horse,

Because of your raging against me, and because your arrogance has come up into my ears, therefore I will put my hook in your nose and my bridle in your lips, and I will turn you back by the way by which you came.
